moral_character_required.quote: An applicant for any license under this chapter must be deemed by the commissioner to be competent, trustworthy, financially responsible, and of good personal and business reputation.

exams.name: Written examination for insurance producer license
exams.notes: Tests knowledge of lines of authority applied for, duties/responsibilities of insurance producer or consultant, and insurance laws/regulations of the state. Exam grade determined by commissioner to indicate satisfactory knowledge.
exams.jurisdiction: state (commissioner-approved, may be administered by outside testing service)
exams.quote: A resident individual applying for an insurance producer license or an insurance consultant license must pass a written examination unless exempt under section 26.1-26-25.

required.quote: any individual licensed as a resident insurance producer or resident insurance consultant shall provide the commissioner evidence, as required by the commissioner, that the individual attended or participated in continuing education of not less than twenty-four hours of approved coursework, of which three hours must be in ethics.

hours_per_period.quote: continuing education of not less than twenty-four hours of approved coursework, of which three hours must be in ethics

period_years.quote: Reports of continuing education must be made at the end of a two-year period.

topical_requirements.quote: twenty-four hours of approved coursework, of which three hours must be in ethics

available.quote: the commissioner shall issue a nonresident person a nonresident insurance producer license if: a. The person is currently licensed as a resident and is in good standing in the person's home state

requirements.value: Nonresident license available if: currently licensed as resident in good standing in home state; submitted proper request and paid fees; submitted home state application or uniform application; home state awards nonresident licenses to ND residents on same basis. Exam waived if previously licensed in another state for same lines of authority.
requirements.quote: The commissioner shall waive any requirements for a nonresident license applicant with a valid license from the insurance producer's home state, except the requirements imposed by section 26.1-26-20, if the applicant's home state awards nonresident licenses to residents of this state on the same basis.

national_association.quote: "Uniform application" means the current version of the national association of insurance commissioners uniform application for resident and nonresident insurance producer licensing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Materially untrue statement in the license application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A materially untrue statement in the license application.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acquiring or attempting to acquire a license through misrepresentation or fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An acquisition or attempt to acquire a license through misrepresentation or fraud.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found to have cheated on an examination for an insurance license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant has been found to have been cheating on an examination for an insurance license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any cause for which issuance of the license could have been refused had it then existed and been known to the commissioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any cause for which issuance of the license could have been refused had it then existed and been known to the commissioner at the time of issuance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or offense with direct bearing on ability to serve the public as an insurance producer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant or licensee has been convicted of a felony or convicted of an offense, as defined by section 12.1-01-04, determined by the commissioner to have a direct bearing upon a person's ability to serve the public as an insurance producer, insurance consultant, or surplus lines insurance producer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraudulent, coercive, or dishonest practices, or incompetence, untrustworthiness, or financial irresponsibility
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the conduct of affairs under the license, the licensee has used fraudulent, coercive, or dishonest practices, or has shown oneself to be incompetent, untrustworthy, or financially irresponsible.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation of the terms of any actual or proposed insurance contract
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A misrepresentation of the terms of any actual or proposed insurance contract.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly solicited, procured, or sold unnecessary or excessive insurance coverage
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been found to have knowingly solicited, procured, or sold unnecessary or excessive insurance coverage to any person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Forging another's name to an application for insurance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has forged another's name to an application for insurance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improper withholding, misappropriating, or converting moneys belonging to policyholders, insurers, beneficiaries, or others
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An improper withholding of, misappropriating of, or converting to one's own use any moneys belonging to policyholders, insurers, beneficiaries, or others received in the course of one's insurance business.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty of any unfair trade practice or fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been found guilty of any unfair trade practice defined in this title or fraud.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of or noncompliance with any insurance laws or lawful rules or orders of the commissioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of or noncompliance with any insurance laws of this state or a violation of or noncompliance with any lawful rules or orders of the commissioner or of a commissioner of another state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: License suspended or revoked in any other state, province, district, or territory
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee's license has been suspended or revoked in any other state, province, district, or territory for any reason or purpose other than noncompliance with continuing education programs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refused to respond within twenty days to written request by commissioner for information regarding potential violation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant or licensee has refused to respond within twenty days to a written request by the commissioner for information regarding any potential violation of this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Without prior written approval from commissioner, communicating with a complainant in attempt to have them dismiss their complaint
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Without express prior written approval from the commissioner, the licensee communicates with a person who the licensee knows has contacted the department regarding an alleged violation committed by the licensee in an attempt to have the complainant dismiss the complaint.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly accepts insurance business from an individual who is not licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee knowingly accepts insurance business from an individual who is not licensed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly fails to comply with a court order imposing child support obligation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant or licensee knowingly fails to comply with a court order imposing child support obligation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fails to file required returns or pay taxes due or comply with court order directing payment of income tax
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The applicant or licensee fails to file the required returns or pay the taxes due under chapter 57-38 or comply with a court order directing payment of any income tax or employer income tax withholding imposed by chapter 57-38.

definition_quote.value: "Insurance producer" means a person required to be licensed under the laws of this state to sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance.
definition_quote.quote: "Insurance producer" means a person required to be licensed under the laws of this state to sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance.

methods_authorized.quote: "Sell" means to exchange a contract of insurance by any means, for money or its equivalent, on behalf of an insurance company. "Solicit" means attempting to sell insurance or asking or urging a person to apply for a particular kind of insurance from a particular company. "Negotiate" means the act of conferring directly with or offering advice directly to a purchaser or prospective purchaser of a particular contract of insurance concerning any of the substantive benefits, terms, or conditions of the contract

lines_of_authority.quote: An insurance producer or surplus lines insurance producer may receive a license to market products under one or more of the following lines: 1. Life ... 2. Accident and health or sickness ... 3. Property ... 4. Casualty ... 5. Variable life and variable annuity

resident_license_available.quote: An individual applying for a resident insurance producer license shall make application to the commissioner on the uniform application

nonresident_license_available.quote: the commissioner shall issue a nonresident person a nonresident insurance producer license if

business_entity_license_available.quote: A business entity acting as an insurance producer must obtain an insurance producer license. Application must be made using the uniform business entity application.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: The business entity has designated a licensed individual principal insurance producer responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws, rules, and regulations of this state

temporary_license_available.quote: The commissioner may issue a temporary license as an insurance producer for a period not to exceed one hundred eighty days without requiring an examination

temporary_license_max_days.quote: The commissioner may issue a temporary license as an insurance producer for a period not to exceed one hundred eighty days without requiring an examination

appointment_required_to_represent_insure.quote: An insurance producer may not act as an agent of an insurer unless the insurance producer becomes an appointed agent of that insurer.

appointment_fee.value: Fee set per section 26.1-01-07; renewal appointment fee also set per section 26.1-01-07
appointment_fee.quote: An insurer shall pay an appointment fee for each insurance producer appointed by the insurer in the amount and method of payment set forth in section 26.1-01-07.

appointment_termination_reporting_days.quote: An insurer or authorized representative of the insurer that terminates the appointment, employment, contract, or other insurance business relationship with an insurance producer shall notify the commissioner within thirty days following the effective date of the termination

additional_fee_for_commercial_business_a.quote: an insurance producer may charge a fee for any services rendered in connection with the sale, solicitation, negotiation, placement, or servicing of an insurance contract, if the following conditions are met: a. The fees may not be charged on a personal lines account

misconduct_reporting_to_department_days.quote: An insurance producer shall report to the commissioner any administrative action taken against the insurance producer's license in another jurisdiction or by another governmental agency in this state within thirty days of the final disposition of the matter.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: The commissioner may verify the insurance producer's licensing status through the insurance producer database maintained by the national association of insurance commissioners, its affiliates, or subsidiaries.

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: A nonresident insurance producer who moves from one state to another state or a resident insurance producer who moves from this state to another state shall file a change of address and provide certification from the new resident state within thirty days of the change of legal residence.

fingerprint_submission_required.quote: An individual applying for a resident producer license shall complete a criminal history record check as provided in section 12-60-24.
